items.content_html:
Here’s my thought on Failed to load state: unsupported checkable object kind var - #2 by apparentlymart - Terraform - HashiCorp Discuss

I have spacelift stacks managed with open tofu and stacks managed with terraform… Due to this very issue I think, I ran into a problem where a terraform-managed spacelift stack couldn’t use the terraform_remote_state data resource to load the state of the open-tofu managed stacks because of state file differences

Note

This is one of [[ my-thoughts ]]. I picked this up from Waylon Walker(https://thoughts.waylonwalker.com). It’s a short note that I make about someone else’s content online. Learn more about the process Thoughts
